beats.text: ChatGPT launched as a research preview.
beats.note: OpenAI said on 30 November 2022 that it was free for now, so it could gather feedback on strengths and weaknesses.

beats.text: One million people signed up within five days.
beats.note: Sam Altman posted that it launched on Wednesday and had crossed 1 million users.

beats.text: Altman called the compute costs eye-watering.
beats.note: He estimated single-digit cents per chat and said it would have to be monetised somehow.

beats.context: Estimated monthly users by January 2023, according to UBS analysis of Similarweb data.

beats.text: TikTok took nine months to reach the same mark.
beats.note: Instagram took two and a half years, per the same data. UBS said it had not seen a faster ramp in 20 years.

beats.text: A preview meant to collect feedback became the fastest ramp UBS had seen.

beats.line: The AI era started as an experiment.
